text: Normalize bundler virtual CSS ids at the adapter boundary so Webpack slash-prefixed decoded ids still reach the NUL-prefixed stylesheet loader.
Keep ecosystem-specific migration policy inside its adapter; use-case orchestration must call adapter hooks instead of checking adapter IDs.
Keep runtime artifact storage, serialization, and mounting behind separate ports; do not let a runtime sheet own DOM lifecycle and CSS rendering in one implementation.
Keep Tailwind code generation pure at the artifact boundary; filesystem writes belong to an injected writer adapter owned by the CLI composition root.
Keep CSS stylesheet state separate from condition parsing and rule serialization; compose those policies through a focused serializer instead of one monolithic createStylesheet module.

Do not compare built-in adapter, source, target, backend, pattern, validator, lowering, or pipeline identities using raw strings; use the owning registry's TypeScript enum and neutral interface metadata.
Keep migration orchestration free of direct Node filesystem effects; inject an owned project-file port and keep source discovery on the shared workspace.
Avoid untyped registry identity literals in tests and orchestration; use the owning TypeScript enum or branded identifier.

Never apply a codemod emission when it reports an unpreserved residual; preserve the source with a typed skip marker, and mark residuals preserved only when a target carrier explicitly retains their semantics.
Do not materialize dynamic CSS into a target-specific placeholder before representation negotiation; preserve authored expression provenance and let a validated native or portable carrier consume it.
prescription: Negotiate target representation first, or retain enough typed lowering provenance to restore the authored dynamic expression.

text: Do not retain deprecated callable strategy aliases or duplicate internal resolver method names; keep one typed object/interface contract and update callers atomically.
Keep adapter-definition helpers under one scoped CodemodAdapterKit; concrete adapters should not import parallel free utility functions for the same concern.
Use const-enum-backed tags for finite registry and semantic discriminants; keep raw strings only at authored, serialized, or external AST protocol boundaries.
prescription: Define the tag beside the owning contract, use it for control flow, and provide explicit ordered registry arrays instead of Object.values.

text: Keep source-pass primitives in one owner module; do not duplicate applyEdits, matchBlock, or computeExcludedRanges across migration domains.
Delete internal compatibility aliases once callers use the canonical helper; do not preserve rename scaffolding.

Do not ship partial hardcoded utility or variant fallback catalogs in ecosystem adapters; require a loaded project resolver or official/default artifact, otherwise preserve source with a typed unknown-utility residual.

Use explicit depth-first stacks for externally sized AST, generated-CSS, semantic-rule, token, or config-tree traversals; keep recursion only for small bounded semantic helpers where stack state would penalize the hot path.

Do not replace an ecosystem's effective utility, condition, or JSX style-prop contract with a partial adapter-local list. Resolve project vocabulary through the official loader or generated artifact; if evidence is unavailable, preserve source semantics and fail closed.
Proof harness package loaders must resolve from the migrated project root before workspace fallbacks; do not ignore the injected project root.
